issues.problem: The tub leaves only about 14 cm in front of much of the storage cabinet, making it difficult to stand at the cabinet and open or use its storage.
issues.fix: Move the tub farther from the cabinet, leaving usable standing and door-opening space in front of the cabinet.

issues.problem: The shower towel is entirely above its towel rack, with its bottom at 2.3 m. It is not supported by the rack and is too high for convenient use.
issues.fix: Lower the towel onto the towel rack so that it hangs from a reachable bar.
